card.title: Meta Quest 3 Tracking Not Working and Travel Mode Won't Turn Off

source.title: Meta Quest 3 Tracking Not Working and Travel Mode Won't Turn Off

claims.statement: A Quest 3 that keeps reverting to Travel Mode and won't track is usually a front tracking camera fault: replace the depth camera if passthrough works, or the front cameras (and possibly depth camera) if passthrough fails.
Don't factory reset as a test: if the cameras are faulty, setup needs tracking and the headset soft-bricks.
Replacement cameras need new thermal putty; front cover removal can damage sensors.

procedure: Force Travel Mode off; restart; clear boundary data.
Replace depth camera or front cameras; reapply thermal putty.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Factory reset with faulty tracking cameras can leave the headset unable to complete setup.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
